3. Reasoning derives a correction to a prior artifact (model definition) from the observed diagnosis — plan to fix.

4. Reasoning diagnoses shape/matrix-orientation error and prescribes a specific fix (event-0015: "W has shape (64,128)... therefore output is F @ W^T + b. Correction...").

5. Action modifying existing artifact (patch via sed/python replace) to correct defect — targeted repair of prior artifact.

6. Observation provides quantitative result that reasoning uses as evidence for margin/feasibility (event-0013/0017: optimal losses). Evidential support.

7. Verification action designed to test all stated success criteria independently; observation confirms pass/fail per criterion. This is "validates against stated success criteria" ternary? Could be binary: verification action + observation verifying criteria. Or unary on observation: criteria-satisfaction report.

8. Reasoning anticipates alternative invocation conventions / hidden test behaviors and hedges by satisfying both (robustness-driven design). This is a planning/design mechanism: designing an approach robust to an ambiguity in evaluation convention.

9. Reasoning verifies invariant/property of artifact unchanged (non-output-layer params bitwise identical, weights.pt unmodified) — assertion of invariant preservation, checked by action and confirmed by observation. Could be "verifies invariant preservation".

Supported by event-0013 reasoning ("To be robust against either way the test harness invokes the model, I'll optimize for both possible call patterns"). Also event-0019 reasoning about edge cases. exclusion: reasoning ignores the failure; reasoning's explanation targets a different failure; observation reports success.

definition: "The action modifies an already-created artifact so that it matches the corrective change specified in the reasoning, leaving unrelated content intact."

I'll phrase as "the modification is confined to the diagnosed defect".

F: DERIVES_DECISION_FROM_MEASURED_RESULT
params: decision_reasoning (reasoning), measurement_observation (observation).
definition: "The reasoning uses quantitative results reported in the observation to select among candidate options or to set a baseline for a decision."
assertion: observation reports measured values (losses, counts, metrics); reasoning compares/uses them to choose a course of action or establish a threshold/baseline.
exclusion: reasoning mentions the numbers only descriptively without deciding; the observation provides no measurement.

G: HEDGES_AGAINST_INTERPRETATION_AMBIGUITY
definition: "The reasoning deliberately chooses a solution that satisfies multiple plausible interpretations of an underspecified requirement, so the outcome remains correct regardless of which interpretation is applied."
params: reasoning.
assertion: reasoning identifies an ambiguity/alternative conventions in how the requirement or interface may be exercised; reasoning states the chosen solution covers all of them.
exclusion: reasoning commits to a single interpretation without acknowledging alternatives; reasoning concerns an unrelated uncertainty.

H: VERIFICATION_CONFIRMS_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA
params: criteria_reasoning (reasoning), verification_action (action), result_observation (observation).
definition: "An executed check evaluates one or more previously enumerated acceptance criteria against the produced artifact, and its result reports whether each criterion is satisfied."
assertion: reasoning enumerates acceptance criteria to be checked; action independently exercises the artifact against those criteria; observation reports per-criterion outcomes (pass/fail values).
exclusion: criteria are not identified before the check; the check does not evaluate the stated criteria; the observation gives no per-criterion outcome.

I: VERIFIES_PRESERVATION_CONSTRAINT
params: constraint_reasoning (reasoning), check_action (action), check_observation (observation).
definition: "A check confirms that components which had to remain unchanged were in fact left unmodified, as required by a preservation constraint stated in the reasoning."
assertion: reasoning states that certain elements must remain unmodified/protected; action inspects those elements (comparison, hash, metadata); observation reports they are unchanged (or changed only where permitted).
exclusion: no preservation constraint is stated; check only measures the target outcome; observation doesn't address the untouched elements.

candidate_predicates.name: IS_FAILURE_DIAGNOSIS
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning identifies a specific cause for an observed failure, error, or mismatch, explaining why it occurred rather than merely restating the error.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that explains the cause of the failure.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning attributes an observed failure to an identifiable cause (for example a misread configuration, an incorrect shape/orientation, or a wrong structural assumption).
The attribution is presented as an explanation of why the failure occurred.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only echoes or paraphrases the error message without explaining its cause.
The reasoning only proposes a retry or a different task without explaining the failure.
The reasoning reports success rather than explaining a failure.

candidate_predicates.name: IS_CORRECTIVE_CHANGE_SPEC
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning specifies the exact modification required to eliminate a previously diagnosed defect, including the corrected form of the affected element.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text stating the concrete corrective change to apply.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names the defective element and states the concrete corrected form (for example a corrected expression, orientation, or structural parameter).
The stated change is confined to the identified defect rather than redefining unrelated parts.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only asserts that something is wrong without saying how to correct it.
The reasoning proposes an entirely new approach instead of a correction to the existing element.

candidate_predicates.name: TESTS_HYPOTHESIS_WITH_PROBE
candidate_predicates.definition: A targeted inspection action tests a specific structural or behavioral uncertainty asserted in the reasoning, and the resulting observation provides interpretable evidence resolving that uncertainty.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action performing the targeted inspection or query.

parameters.name: hypothesis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the specific structural/behavioral hypothesis or uncertainty being tested.

parameters.name: probe_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the inspected information relevant to the hypothesis.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific uncertainty about the system's structure or behavior and proposes a candidate answer.
The action is designed to retrieve exactly the information that discriminates between the candidate answer and its alternatives.
The observation reports that discriminating information.
exclusion_conditions: The action is unrelated to the stated uncertainty.
The observation does not contain information that discriminates the hypothesis from alternatives.
No identifiable hypothesis or uncertainty motivates the inspection.

candidate_predicates.name: DIAGNOSIS_EXPLAINS_OBSERVED_FAILURE
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explains the cause of a failure reported in the observation, connecting the reported error to a specific defect in a prior artifact or assumption.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning attributing the reported failure to a specific cause.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the error, exception, or mismatch to be explained.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports an error, exception, or mismatch.
The reasoning attributes that specific reported failure to an identifiable cause with content correspondence between the error and the explanation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning ignores or does not address the reported failure.
The explanation concerns a different failure than the one reported in the observation.
The observation reports successful execution rather than a failure.

candidate_predicates.name: APPLIES_MINIMAL_FIX_TO_ARTIFACT
candidate_predicates.definition: The action modifies an already-created artifact so that it embodies the corrective change specified in the reasoning, without introducing unrelated changes.

parameters.name: fix_action
parameters.description: The action editing or rewriting the existing artifact.

parameters.name: fix_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the defect and the corrective change the edit implements.

assertion_conditions: The action operates on an artifact that already exists rather than creating an unrelated new one.
The modification implements the change identified in the reasoning.
The modification is confined to the defective element and preserves the artifact's remaining content or contract.
exclusion_conditions: The action produces a brand-new artifact unrelated to any prior correction.
The action's change is not tied to any stated corrective specification.
The action merely re-executes an unchanged artifact.

candidate_predicates.name: DERIVES_DECISION_FROM_MEASURED_RESULT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning uses quantitative results reported in the observation to select among candidate options or to establish a baseline against which a decision is made.

parameters.name: decision_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that compares measured values and selects a course of action or baseline.

parameters.name: measurement_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the measured values used in the decision.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports measured quantities (metrics, losses, counts, or comparable numeric outcomes).
The reasoning compares or reuses those quantities to choose among alternatives or to fix a baseline/threshold for subsequent action.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only repeats the numbers without using them to decide anything.
The observation contains no measurement relevant to the decision.

candidate_predicates.name: HEDGES_AGAINST_INTERPRETATION_AMBIGUITY
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning deliberately adopts a solution that satisfies multiple plausible interpretations of an underspecified requirement or interface, so the outcome remains valid regardless of which interpretation is applied.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text identifying the ambiguity and justifying the ambiguity-covering solution.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies alternative conventions or interpretations under which the requirement or interface may be exercised.
The reasoning states that the chosen solution satisfies all of the identified interpretations simultaneously.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning commits to a single interpretation without acknowledging alternatives.
The acknowledged uncertainty is unrelated to how the requirement or interface will be evaluated.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFICATION_CONFIRMS_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA
candidate_predicates.definition: An executed check evaluates previously enumerated acceptance criteria against the produced artifact, and its result reports whether each criterion is satisfied.

parameters.name: criteria_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning enumerating the acceptance criteria to be verified.

parameters.name: verification_action
parameters.description: The action independently exercising the artifact against those criteria.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning enumerates the acceptance criteria to be checked before or alongside the check.
The action independently exercises the produced artifact against those criteria.
The observation reports identifiable per-criterion outcomes rather than a single undifferentiated success message.
exclusion_conditions: No acceptance criteria are identified for the check.
The check does not evaluate the stated criteria.
The observation provides no outcome that can be mapped to the criteria.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFIES_PRESERVATION_CONSTRAINT
candidate_predicates.definition: A check confirms that components required to remain unchanged were in fact left unmodified, enforcing a preservation constraint stated in the reasoning.

parameters.name: constraint_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating which elements must remain unmodified or protected.

parameters.name: check_action
parameters.description: The action inspecting the protected elements (comparison, hashing, metadata inspection).

parameters.name: check_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting whether those elements are unchanged.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states that specific elements (files, layers, parameters, or regions) must remain unmodified.
The action inspects exactly those elements rather than only measuring the target outcome.
The observation reports that the protected elements are unchanged, or changed only where explicitly permitted.
exclusion_conditions: No preservation constraint is stated in the reasoning.
The check only measures the target outcome and never inspects the protected elements.
The observation does not address the state of the protected elements.
